properties.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued November 15 at 3:13AM HST by NWS Honolulu HI
properties.description:
A moderate, long-period north swell from 350 to 360 degrees will
build across Hawaiian waters and peak later today and Monday as
the period shortens to 12 seconds. The swell will produce
moderate to heavy surges in north-facing harbors, especially at
Kahului and Hilo Harbors. Mariners using these harbors should
exercise caution when mooring or launching vessels and when
entering or leaving port. The swell will diminish Tuesday.

* WHERE...Downtown Juneau, Thane, and Douglas

* WHEN...Until noon AKST today.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree

between Downtown Juneau and Thane, with localized gusts near the AJ
Dock and AML Dock around 45 mph. Frequent gusts to 30 mph with
sporadic wind gusts up to 40 mph will be possible for the Downtown

properties.areaDesc: Coastal Del Norte; Northern Coastal Humboldt; Southwestern Humboldt; Coastal Mendocino
properties.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 15 at 5:07AM PST until November 16 at 4:00AM PST by NWS Eureka CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 22 to 25 feet with sets up to 28
feet possible.

* WHERE...Coastal Del Norte, Northern Coastal Humboldt,
Southwestern Humboldt and Coastal Mendocino Counties.

* WHEN...From noon today to 4 AM PST Monday. .

* IMPACTS...Dangerous surf conditions and localized beach
erosion. Beachcombing is highly discouraged!.
properties.instruction:
Large breaking waves along the coast will lead to increased wave
run-up on beaches with waves topping and washing over large rocks
and jetties. These large waves can be erratic and unpredictable.
Use extra caution near the surf zone as these large waves will be
capable of sweeping people into the frigid and turbulent ocean
water. Mariners traversing the bar are urged to exercise extreme
caution or stay in port until the threat subsides. Please contact
the U.S. Coast Guard for information regarding harbor and bar
closures.

NWSheadline: HIGH SURF ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM NOON TODAY TO 4 AM PST MONDAY

properties.areaDesc: Atka and Adak
properties.headline: High Wind Warning issued November 15 at 3:58AM AKST until November 17 at 6:00AM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 45 to 60 mph with gusts as high as 80 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Atka and Adak.

* WHEN...From 6 PM Monday to 6 AM AKST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...High winds may move loose debris, damage property, and
cause power outages. Travel will be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The strongest winds are will be over Adak,
with wind gusts as high as 80 mph, with Atka winds expected to see
gusts to 60 mph. Winds rapidly increase in strength late Monday
evening and peak early Tuesday morning as a strong low pressure
system moves through the Bering. Winds will gradually lighten but
remain gusty through Wednesday.
properties.instruction:
People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown around
or damaged by the wind. Prepare for the possibility of widespread
power outages. Use caution if you must drive.

worsen this afternoon with breaking waves reaching 25 to 30 ft.
Dangerous surf conditions persist into Monday morning. Waves
and surf remain hazardous Monday, but gradually diminish through
Monday evening.

* WHERE...Beaches of South Central Oregon Coast and Curry County
Coast. This includes Charleston, Port Orford, Gold Beach, and
Brookings.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM PST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Extremely large breaking waves will create very
hazardous conditions along beaches and area shorelines. Waves
will inundate beaches and surge into normally dry areas.
Infrastructure damage and significant beach erosion can be
expected.
properties.instruction:

and life-threatening surf conditions. Stay off of beaches, rocks,
jetties, piers, and other waterside infrastructure.

properties.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued November 15 at 3:26AM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
A large west to northwesterly swell will continue to produce
breaking waves at the Morro Bay and Ventura Harbor entrances
through at least this afternoon. These conditions have a history
of capsizing vessels of various sizes resulting in serious injury
or death, even to the most experienced mariners. Mariners are
urged to stay clear of these harbor entrances. For more
information, contact the local harbor patrol or coast guard
station and continue to monitor NOAA Weather Radio for the latest
weather information.

properties.areaDesc: San Luis Obispo County Beaches; Santa Barbara County Central Coast Beaches
properties.headline: High Surf Advisory issued November 15 at 3:24AM PST until November 17 at 3:00PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the High Surf Warning, dangerously large breaking
waves of 14 to 18 feet with dangerous rip currents. For the High
Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 10 to 15 feet with
dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...San Luis Obispo County Beaches and Santa Barbara
County Central Coast Beaches.

* WHEN...For the High Surf Warning, until 4 PM PST this
afternoon. For the High Surf Advisory, from 4 PM this
afternoon to 3 PM PST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Powerful waves and strong rip currents will pose an
exceptional risk of ocean drowning and damage to coastal
structures like piers and jetties. Large breaking waves can
cause injury, wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize
small boats near shore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A series of west-northwesterly swells will
create an extended period of large surf into the week, with the
potential for WARNING level surf again late tonight through
Monday. Areas that may see most significant impacts will be
west- northwest facing beaches, with widespread flooding likely
at low lying areas such as at Oceano Dunes. Breaking waves may
impact the Cayucos and Pismo Beach piers as well as the Morro
Bay Harbor entrance.
properties.instruction:
Everyone should remain out of the water due to life-threatening
surf conditions. Stay off of jetties, piers, and other water side
infrastructure.
